## Hi, I'm Tori

I'm a graduate student in the **M.S. in Applied Data Analytics at Boston University**, finishing in
December 2026, and a **Contract Specialist at NAVSEA** in Washington, DC. My work sits where data
meets business decisions: I like taking large, messy datasets, building the pipeline that cleans
them, and turning the results into something a decision-maker can act on.

In my coursework I work end to end in the cloud, processing data with **PySpark on AWS EC2**,
building and comparing machine learning models in **Spark ML**, and publishing reproducible
reports with **Quarto**. In my day job I see how careful analysis, clear documentation and
attention to detail keep complex programs on track.

## Career Goals

I'm looking for roles at the intersection of **data, contracts and business strategy**, where I
can use analytics and machine learning to make operations more transparent, efficient and
well-reasoned. Long term, I want to keep combining analytical rigor with a strong understanding of
how organizations, policy and agreements actually work.
